_comment: Planet-in-house snippets (docs/INTERPRETATION.md §1). 1–2 sentences, second person. Keys are house numbers 1–12. Only 'approved' planets are shown in the app.

1.meaning: You tend to shine most when you are simply being yourself, and people often notice you before you say a word. Your growth comes from leading your own life on your own terms.

2.meaning: You may feel most like yourself when you are building something steady and lasting with your own skills and values. Knowing what you are worth, not just what you have, helps you feel secure.

3.meaning: You tend to come alive through talking, learning and staying curious about everything around you. Writing, teaching or simply sharing ideas can be where you shine.

4.meaning: Home, family and your roots may sit at the center of who you are, even if you show it quietly. You tend to shine brightest when you feel you belong somewhere.

5.meaning: You tend to shine when you are creating, playing or sharing what you love with others. Joy is not a side project for you; it is part of how you grow.

6.meaning: You may feel most like yourself when you are being useful, improving things and keeping your days in good order. Your real strength often shows in small daily habits.

7.meaning: You tend to discover who you are through close partnerships, whether in love, friendship or work. You may shine brightest as part of a strong pair.

8.meaning: You may be drawn to what lies beneath the surface, in people and in life, and you are not afraid of deep conversations. Times of big change often reveal your real strength.

9.meaning: You tend to shine when you are exploring, through travel, study or big questions about meaning. Sharing what you have learned can make you a natural guide for others.

10.meaning: You may feel most like yourself when you are working toward a goal that others can see. Your reputation and achievements matter to you, and you are willing to work for both.

11.meaning: You tend to shine in friendships, groups and causes that look toward the future. Sharing a vision with like-minded people can bring out your best.

12.meaning: You may shine most in quiet ways, through reflection, imagination or helping others behind the scenes. Time alone can be how you recharge and find out who you are.

1.meaning: Your feelings tend to show on your face, and people often sense your mood right away. You may need to feel free to be yourself in order to feel safe.

2.meaning: You may feel calm when life is steady and your basic needs are taken care of. Comfort, good food and familiar things can soothe you more than you expect.

3.meaning: You tend to process feelings by talking or writing them out, and a good conversation can lift your mood quickly. Staying mentally busy may help you feel at ease.

4.meaning: Home and family can be your emotional anchor, and you may need a private, cozy space to truly relax. Caring for the people closest to you often feels natural.

5.meaning: You may need fun, play and creative outlets to feel emotionally full. Being appreciated for who you are can mean a lot to you.

6.meaning: You tend to feel calmer when your days have a clear routine and you are being helpful. Looking after small details can be how you handle stress.

7.meaning: You may feel most at peace when you have a close partner or friend to share life with. Harmony in your relationships can deeply affect your mood.

8.meaning: Your feelings can run very deep, and you may share them only with people you fully trust. You tend to need emotional honesty more than small talk.

9.meaning: You may need room to explore, learn and see the big picture to feel emotionally free. New places and new ideas can lift your spirits.

10.meaning: You may feel secure when you are respected and making progress toward your goals. Your public role or work can be closely tied to how you feel inside.

11.meaning: Friends and community can feel like family to you, and being part of a group helps you feel at home. Sharing hopes for the future may lift your mood.

12.meaning: You may need regular quiet time to sort out your feelings, which often run deeper than you show. Rest, music or time near water can help you recharge.

1.meaning: You tend to think out loud and speak your mind quickly, so people usually know where you stand. Your words can be a big part of how others see you.

2.meaning: You tend to think in practical terms, focusing on what is useful and worth your time. Over the years, your ideas and skills can become real resources.

3.meaning: Your mind tends to be busy and curious, and you may enjoy reading, writing and chatting with everyone around you. Learning new things can come easily to you.

4.meaning: You may think best at home and often turn your thoughts toward family, memories and the past. Talks with loved ones can shape your views more than you realize.

5.meaning: You tend to think in creative, playful ways, and you may enjoy games, stories and making people laugh. Expressing ideas with flair can come naturally to you.

6.meaning: You tend to have a sharp, organized mind that enjoys solving everyday problems. Lists, plans and clear methods may help you think at your best.

7.meaning: You may think best in conversation, and you often weigh both sides before deciding. Talking things through with a partner can sharpen your ideas.

8.meaning: Your mind tends to dig deep, and you may be drawn to mysteries, research and what others leave unsaid. You often notice the real reasons behind people's words.

9.meaning: You tend to think in big ideas and may love learning about other cultures, beliefs and places. Teaching, travel or study can stretch your mind.

10.meaning: Your words and ideas may play a big role in your work and public life. You tend to think in a focused, goal-driven way and plan for the long run.

11.meaning: You tend to think about the future and enjoy sharing ideas with friends and groups. Fresh, unusual ideas may come to you often.

12.meaning: Your mind may work in quiet, intuitive ways, and some of your best ideas can come during alone time or even in dreams. You might express yourself best through writing, art or music.

1.meaning: You may come across as warm, charming and easy to like, and people often feel at ease around you. Caring about how you present yourself can be part of your style.

2.meaning: You may love beautiful, lasting things and feel happiest when life is comfortable and secure. Your values are steady, and you tend to show love through care others can see and touch.

3.meaning: You tend to show love through kind words, messages and good conversation. Friendly ties with siblings, classmates or neighbors may matter a lot to you.

4.meaning: You may find love and comfort in home life, and a beautiful, peaceful home can mean a great deal to you. Family warmth often shapes how you love.

5.meaning: You tend to love romance, creativity and fun, and you may fall for people who make you laugh. Art, play and celebration can bring out your warmest side.

6.meaning: You may show love by doing helpful things, and you can bring grace and kindness to everyday work. Pleasant routines and a friendly workplace can matter a lot to you.

7.meaning: Partnership may be central to your happiness, and you tend to value fairness, respect and balance with others. You may naturally attract people and bring them together.

8.meaning: You tend to love deeply and intensely, wanting real closeness rather than something casual. Trust and emotional honesty can matter more to you than appearances.

9.meaning: You may be drawn to people from different places or backgrounds, and love can feel like an adventure to you. Shared ideals and learning together can bring you close.

10.meaning: Your charm and taste may help you in your work and public life, and people often see you as gracious. You may be drawn to partners who share your goals.

11.meaning: Friendships may be one of your greatest joys, and love can grow out of shared interests or groups. You tend to value freedom and equality in relationships.

12.meaning: You may love quietly and deeply, sometimes keeping your feelings private for a long time. Kindness, compassion and a bit of romance can come naturally to you.

1.meaning: You tend to act quickly and boldly, and people may sense your energy right away. Taking the lead can come naturally, though patience may take practice.

2.meaning: You may put steady effort into building security and protecting what you value. Once you set a goal, you tend to keep going until it is done.

3.meaning: Your energy may show in quick thinking and lively, direct talk. You tend to enjoy debates, short trips and staying busy.

4.meaning: Much of your drive may go into home and family, protecting and building a place of your own. You may feel strongly about where you come from.

5.meaning: You tend to put passion into creativity, play and romance, and you may love a bit of friendly competition. Doing what you love can give you endless energy.

6.meaning: You tend to be a hard, efficient worker who likes to get things done. Staying active and keeping a good daily rhythm can help you handle stress.

7.meaning: You may bring a lot of energy into partnerships, and you can be a strong ally or a strong opponent. Learning to share decisions can make your relationships stronger.

8.meaning: Your drive may run deep and quiet, showing up as determination when things get serious. You tend to be strong in a crisis and do not give up easily.

9.meaning: You tend to put energy into exploring, learning and standing up for what you believe. Travel, sports or big causes can fire you up.

10.meaning: You may be strongly driven to succeed and be seen for what you achieve. Hard work toward a clear goal can bring out your best.

11.meaning: Your energy may come alive in groups, teams and causes you care about. You tend to push for change and rally others around shared goals.

12.meaning: Your drive may work quietly behind the scenes, and you might not always show when you are upset. Learning to name your anger calmly can help you use your energy well.

1.meaning: You may come across as warm, hopeful and generous, and people often feel uplifted around you. Your growth tends to come from trusting yourself and trying new things.

2.meaning: You may grow by building on your talents and staying true to what you value. You tend to be generous, and you can learn that real security comes from within.

3.meaning: You tend to grow through learning, reading and talking with all kinds of people. A curious, open mind can open many doors for you.

4.meaning: You may find growth and comfort through home and family, and you might enjoy a big, welcoming household. Your roots can give you the strength to reach far.

5.meaning: You tend to grow through creativity, play and sharing joy with others. Hobbies, art or time with young people can bring out your generous spirit.

6.meaning: You may grow through meaningful daily work and helping others in practical ways. A positive attitude at work can make you someone people rely on.

7.meaning: You may grow a great deal through partnerships, and you tend to attract generous, supportive people. Working with others can open new paths for you.

8.meaning: You may grow through deep bonds, honest sharing and facing life's big changes with courage. Trust and openness can bring you closer to others than you expect.

9.meaning: You tend to grow through travel, study and exploring big questions about life. Teaching, faith or other cultures may become a strong part of your journey.

10.meaning: You may grow through your work and public life, and others may see you as a natural leader or mentor. Staying true to your values can help your reputation grow.

11.meaning: You tend to grow through friendships, communities and shared hopes for the future. Generous friends and group efforts can open new doors for you.

12.meaning: You may grow through quiet reflection, compassion and helping others without needing credit. Time alone, faith or creative dreaming can renew your hope.

1.meaning: You may come across as serious, capable and older than your years, especially when you are young. Over time you can grow into a calm, trusted presence that people lean on.

2.meaning: You may work hard to feel secure and take your responsibilities seriously. With patience, you can build a strong sense of self-worth that does not depend on others.

3.meaning: You may think carefully before you speak and take learning seriously. With practice, you can become a clear, trusted voice whose words carry weight.

4.meaning: Home and family may have asked a lot of you, and you may have felt responsible from an early age. Over time you can build the steady, safe home you value.

5.meaning: You may take creativity and fun seriously, and it can take time to let yourself simply play. As you grow, you can learn that joy is allowed and deserved.

6.meaning: You may be a dedicated, careful worker who wants to do things right. Learning to balance duty with rest can help you build routines that truly support you.

7.meaning: You may take partnerships very seriously and look for loyalty and commitment that can last. With time and patience, you can build relationships on solid trust.

8.meaning: You may approach deep bonds carefully and need time before you fully trust someone. Facing hard feelings honestly can help you grow strong and wise.

9.meaning: You may take your beliefs and studies seriously and want ideas that hold up over time. You can grow into a wise teacher or guide through steady learning.

10.meaning: You may feel a strong sense of duty about your work and how you are seen. With steady effort, you can build a career and reputation that last.

11.meaning: You may choose friends carefully and prefer a few loyal ones over many. Over time you can build a steady circle and take on a trusted role in groups.

12.meaning: You may carry quiet worries that others do not see, and time alone can be important to you. Through reflection and gentle self-care, you can grow calmer and more at peace.

1.meaning: You may come across as original, unpredictable and a little different from the crowd. Being free to be yourself can matter more to you than fitting in.

2.meaning: Your values may be unusual, and you might find your own creative way to feel secure. Sudden changes can push you to try new ways of using your skills.

3.meaning: Your mind may jump to new ideas quickly, and you might think in ways others find surprising. Technology, new subjects or unusual conversations can excite you.

4.meaning: Home life may have been changeable, or you may want an unusual home that fits your own style. Freedom to come and go can help you feel at home.

5.meaning: You may express yourself in bold, unexpected ways, and your creativity can be truly original. You might be drawn to exciting, unusual romances.

6.meaning: You may prefer flexible routines and work that lets you try new methods. Using technology or fresh ideas can make your daily work more exciting.

7.meaning: You may want partnerships that leave room for freedom and individuality. Relationships with unusual or independent people can teach you a lot.

8.meaning: You may face sudden turning points that change how you see yourself and others. Over time, these shifts can free you from old fears and bring fresh insight.

9.meaning: You may be drawn to new ideas, unusual beliefs or far-off places. Your mind tends to question old views and look for your own truth.

10.meaning: Your path at work may take surprising turns, and you might want a career that lets you innovate. Being your own boss or working in new fields can suit you.

11.meaning: You may find your people among free thinkers and groups that want to change the world. Friendships can come and go, but they often spark new ideas.

12.meaning: Your most original ideas may come in quiet moments or from your intuition. Time alone can help you understand the surprising parts of yourself.

1.meaning: You may come across as gentle, dreamy or hard to read, and people may see what they hope to see in you. Your sensitivity can be a quiet gift.

2.meaning: You may value meaning, beauty and kindness more than practical gains. Clear, practical habits can help your ideals feel safe and real.

3.meaning: Your mind may be imaginative and poetic, and you may think in pictures or feelings. Writing, music or storytelling can be a natural way for you to share ideas.

4.meaning: You may carry a dreamy or idealized picture of home and family. Creating a peaceful, gentle home can become your way to feel safe.

5.meaning: You may have a rich imagination and a romantic, artistic heart. Art, music, film or dance can be beautiful outlets for your dreams.

6.meaning: You may want your daily work to feel meaningful and kind to others. Gentle routines and clear plans can help you turn good intentions into steady habits.

7.meaning: You may hope for a soulmate kind of love and tend to see the best in your partners. Keeping your eyes open, as well as your heart, can help your relationships grow.

8.meaning: You may feel deep, almost wordless connections with people, and you can sense what is left unsaid. Clear boundaries can help you share closeness without losing yourself.

9.meaning: You may be drawn to spiritual ideas, faith or dreams of faraway places. Your beliefs tend to be compassionate and full of imagination.

10.meaning: You may want a career that feels meaningful, creative or helpful to others. It can take time to find your path, but your vision can inspire people.

11.meaning: You may dream of a kinder world and find friends who share your ideals. Groups devoted to art, faith or helping others can feel like home.

12.meaning: You may have a deep inner world full of imagination and compassion. Quiet time, art or spiritual practice can help you feel whole and at peace.

1.meaning: You may have a strong, intense presence, and people may sense your depth even when you are quiet. Over time you can reinvent yourself more than once.

2.meaning: You may feel strongly about what you value, and your sense of worth can go through big changes. Learning to let go can make you even stronger.

3.meaning: Your words can be powerful, and you may dig deep into any subject that interests you. Honest, focused conversations can change the way you and others think.

4.meaning: Home and family may hold deep emotions for you, and your roots can shape you powerfully. Working through old family patterns can become a source of strength.

5.meaning: You may put great passion into love and creative projects, and you tend to give your whole heart. Creative work can be a powerful way for you to transform feelings.

6.meaning: You may bring intense focus to your daily work and can transform how things are done. Balancing effort with rest can keep your strength steady.

7.meaning: Your close relationships may be intense and life-changing, and partners can deeply shape who you become. Equal give-and-take can help your bonds stay strong.

8.meaning: You may be drawn to life's deepest questions and to bonds built on total trust. You tend to come through hard times changed and stronger.

9.meaning: You may search deeply for meaning, and your beliefs can change in big, life-shaping ways. Study, travel or faith can transform how you see the world.

10.meaning: You may feel a strong drive to make an impact through your work and to be in charge of your own path. Your career can go through big turning points that make you stronger.

11.meaning: You may want your friendships and groups to mean something deep, and you can help change a community from within. The right friends can transform your hopes for the future.

12.meaning: You may have a powerful inner life, and some of your strength stays hidden even from you at first. Quiet reflection can help you understand deep feelings and let them go.
